label: Soils of New Zealand publishes a nationwide soil reference
summary: DSIR Soil Bureau Bulletin 26 brought together soil classification, regional descriptions and accompanying maps, with specialist contributions across scientific and land-use agencies. The maps and descriptions became reference material for later land information systems.
